title: Sent in from outside
subject: Mathematics
objective: Show that the engine renders a script nobody in the app wrote.

board.sub: This lesson was not built into the app

steps.text: Nobody wrote me into this app. I arrived as a file, and the engine is reading me now.
Here is a seven, in the tens place.
And a four, in the units.
Seven tens and four units. Seventy-four.

ask.prompt: Write the whole number in digits.

steps.text: Rendered by the same tutor, the same board and the same practice loop — with no code change.
